subject: SIG questionnaire - evidence deliverables (SOC 2, pen test, ISO, security deck)
messages:
From: Karen Liu <karen.liu@acmehealth.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@acmehealth.com
Date: 2026-03-02T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: SIG questionnaire + artifacts request

Hi Priyom,

Thanks for taking the SIG earlier this week. As part of our vendor review, our InfoSec team needs the following artifacts to complete the assessment: a completed SIG (preferably as a spreadsheet), a redacted SOC 2 report (Type II) or SOC 2 assertion, a short penetration-test summary (high-level findings and remediation status), an ISO statement (if available), and any security overview deck you can share.

Can you confirm whether you can provide these items and your expected timeline? Ideally we'd like to have the artifacts by EOD Friday (Mar 6) to stay on our procurement timeline. If there are any distribution restrictions on the SOC 2 report please flag them.

Also: are there any pieces you need us to sign (NDA / limited distribution) before you can share the SOC 2?

Thanks,
Karen
Karen Liu
Senior Security Program Manager
Acme Health Systems
--

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Karen Liu <karen.liu@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-03-02T09:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire + artifacts request

Hi Karen — thanks for the clear list. We can deliver everything you requested. Plan below:

- Security deck: I will send our latest deck today (v3).
- SIG: we'll populate the spreadsheet and share a link to the completed doc by tomorrow.
- SOC 2 (Type II): we can provide a redacted PDF after a quick legal review; target is EOD Tue (Mar 3). If you need a fully unredacted copy we require a limited-distribution agreement (standard for customer audits) — happy to have Marissa follow up.
- Pen test summary: Dylan will provide a 1-page summary (no raw findings) — available tomorrow morning.
- ISO statement: we have an attestation we can share (ISO27001 scope statement).

Cc'd Marissa (Legal) and Dylan (Security) to coordinate any redaction and distribution steps. If the EOD Fri timeline is firm, we should be able to meet it; otherwise we'll prioritize SOC 2 + pen test first.

One question: does Acme require a DocuSign for the limited distribution form, or is an email confirmation acceptable?

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0198

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>

Priyom / Dylan — forwarding Acme's request. Legal's standard approach: we deliver a redacted SOC 2 (sensitive customer references removed) under a Limited Distribution Acknowledgement. We can send a short acknowledgement form (attached) for Acme to countersign if they require it.

Quick notes for the package: please ensure the SOC 2 file name indicates it's redacted and that the pen test summary includes the test window and vendor (we do not include raw vuln reports). Dylan, can you confirm the status of remediation for any findings so we can state whether items are remediated or accepted?

Attachment: SOC2-limited-distribution-form.docx

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>

Date: 2026-03-03T08:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: SIG questionnaire + artifacts request

Marissa / Priyom — attaching the pen test summary and ISO attestation. High level:

- Pen test vendor: Red Team Labs (Jan 2026)
- Scope: public-facing inference control plane, authentication, and data-plane ingress controls (no customer data in scope)
- Results: 0 critical, 2 medium, 4 low findings. The two medium items were related to header parsing and a third-party library; both have been patched and validated in our 2026-02-10 release.
- Remediation status: verified and closed; evidence retained in internal Jira SSEC-1123/1124.

I've attached: pen_test_summary.pdf, ISO27001-statement.pdf.

Let me know if Acme wants the short test dates and vendor contact (we can provide an authorization to discuss).

--
Dylan Brooks
Security Engineer, Redwood Inference

- security-deck-v3.pdf (overview of controls, architecture, and data flows)

- pen_test_summary.pdf (1-page summary, vendor + remediation status)

Thanks and talk soon,
